visual_goal: Show detail narrowing from millions of operational lines to tens of thousands of GL lines and on to statements, with drill-back by summarization key and a subledger-to-GL reconciliation that proves the two agree.
prompt: A left-to-right flow that narrows like a river delta in reverse. At the far left, a wide stream of many tiny lines labeled 'Operational events' with '3 million lines a day' beneath. Next, a box 'Posting rules' with one arrow from the stream. Next, a large open book 'Subledger' with one arrow from 'Posting rules'. Next, a funnel, then an open book 'General ledger' with '38,000 lines a day' beneath; one arrow goes from 'Subledger' through the funnel into 'General ledger'. Next, three ever-smaller boxes in a row, 'Trial balance', 'Consolidation', and a single document 'Statements', with one arrow between each. A dotted orange arrow carrying a small key icon runs back from 'General ledger' to 'Subledger' above the funnel. Below the two books, a balance scale labeled 'Reconciliation' with one thin arrow down into it from 'Subledger' and one from 'General ledger', its two pans perfectly level.
alt: Three million operational lines a day pass through posting rules into the subledger, are funnelled into 38,000 GL lines a day, then trial balance, consolidation and statements; a dotted key arrow drills back from the GL to the subledger, and a level balance scale reconciles the two.

visual_goal: Show one €600 merchant booking moving through five balance-sheet accounts that must all return to zero, with only €90 ever becoming revenue.
prompt: A left-to-right money-flow illustration with two tracks. At the far left, an unlabeled traveler figure holding a phone with an amount '€600'. Upper track, a single straight line of thick pipes carrying plain smooth gold coins with blank faces, running strictly left to right in this order: traveler, then a glass jar 'PSP clearing', then a vault 'Safeguarding' labeled '€598.26', then a bank building 'Operating bank' labeled '€90'. The pipe into the bank starts at the right side of the vault. A small orange arrow drops down from 'PSP clearing' into a small box 'Fees' labeled '€1.74'. Lower track, drawn as dotted lines: one dotted arrow from the traveler into a glass jar 'Funds held' labeled '€600'; from it one arrow up-right into a bright green box with a star 'Revenue' labeled '€90' and one arrow right into a glass jar 'Partner payables' labeled '€510'; from 'Partner payables' one arrow into a glass jar 'Payouts in transit'; from that jar one arrow into a small house 'Property'. All glass jars and the vault share the same style, each with a small circular return-arrow icon. Exactly nine arrows.
alt: A €600 booking flows through PSP clearing into safeguarding (€598.26, with €1.74 fees) and €90 to the operating bank, while the €600 liability splits into €510 partner payables, paid out via payouts in transit to the property, and €90 revenue — the only amount that stays.

visual_goal: Show each accounting invariant as a check on the posting path: duplicate detection, balance check rejecting to an owned queue, period check that redirects late events, append-only storage, summarization and reconciliation.
prompt: A left-to-right conveyor belt illustration. At the far left, an envelope with a lightning bolt and a small barcode tag, labeled 'Event'. The envelope rides the belt through three gates, each with its own side exit. The first gate is labeled 'Seen before?'; an upward side arrow leads to a box 'Acknowledge'. Next, a box 'Posting rule' on the belt. The second gate is a balance scale labeled 'Balanced?'; a downward side arrow leads to a tray 'Error queue' held by an unlabeled person. The third gate is a calendar labeled 'Period open?'; a curved side arrow leaves it and rejoins the belt just after the gate, passing a small box 'Open period'. Next on the belt, an open book with a padlock on its spine labeled 'Append-only'. Next, a funnel 'Summarize to GL'. At the far right, a check-mark badge 'Reconciled'.
alt: An event with an ID rides a conveyor through three gates — duplicates are acknowledged and dropped, unbalanced entries go to an owned error queue, late events detour to the open period — before being appended to a locked ledger, summarized to the GL and reconciled.
